edge_cases.title: Missing SKUs across vendors
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Lines absent from a response are 'not_quoted' – never imputed. V3 explains CP-021 in prose; V5 explicitly declines CP-011/CP-012 and is silent on others; V4 rate card note says export 7-ply not offered.
edge_cases.reason: Coverage gaps must be reported, not filled

edge_cases.title: Comments embedded in Excel cells
edge_cases.location: Sheet 'Quotation': rate cell of CP-018 is text; cell notes on CP-015 rate and CP-029 freight
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Numeric rate is the leading number; '(incl. tear strip)' is a scope remark. Cell note on CP-015 says litho via partner (rate inclusive). Cell note on CP-029 says freight assumes full-truck lots (no price impact).

edge_cases.title: Vendor quotes 27 of 30 lines
edge_cases.raw_value: 27 unique line codes (28 rows incl. duplicate CP-011)
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Coverage 27/30; CP-015, CP-029, CP-030 not quoted (no litho; BF26 kraft unavailable – stated in note 8).

edge_cases.title: USD-denominated quote
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Convert at RFx evaluation FX 1 USD = INR 88.5; ignore vendor's indicative rate mentioned in text. Freight included.
edge_cases.reason: Currency normalization; FX exposure noted at vendor level

edge_cases.title: Price per 100 pieces
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Divide by 100 to get per-piece/set price.

edge_cases.title: Rate card partitions/pads per 100 nos (asterisk footnote)
edge_cases.location: Rate card rows marked '*', footnote '* Rate per 100 Nos'
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Asterisked values are per 100 nos; divide by 100.
edge_cases.reason: Footnote-driven unit; only visible if footnote is read

edge_cases.title: 'Per box' unit
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: A 'box' here is the carton itself – 1 box = 1 piece (conversion factor 1). Not a bundle.
edge_cases.reason: Unit semantics ('box' could be misread as bundle/outer)

edge_cases.title: Freight condition buried in footnote
edge_cases.raw_value: Rates FOR Chakan. For supplies to Bengaluru & Hyderabad plants freight extra at actuals.
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: PNQ lines: freight included. BLR/HYD lines: freight excluded -> 5% evaluation loading.
edge_cases.reason: Footnote changes landed cost for 18 lines; must not be treated as fully delivered

edge_cases.title: Per-kg pricing
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Per-piece = rate/kg x reference_weight_g/1000 from rfx_master.
edge_cases.reason: Requires weight-based conversion; billing weight basis should be confirmed at vendor level

edge_cases.title: MOQ constraints
edge_cases.location: V1 MOQ column; V3 table; V5 email

raw_value.VND-1005: MOQ 5,000 for printed boxes; small-run charges below that

edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Flag MOQ > monthly call-off (BR-15). V1 & V3 MOQs on CP-029/CP-030 exceed monthly call-off. V5 MOQ applies to printed lines only.

edge_cases.title: MOQ described in prose, not table
edge_cases.location: Table 1 MOQ cell 'Refer note'; Section 3 paragraph
edge_cases.raw_value: minimum production run of 25,000 pieces per artwork
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: MOQ for CP-015 = 25,000 pcs (below monthly call-off 33,333 – compliant).

edge_cases.title: Lead-time condition in prose
edge_cases.raw_value: first supply 28 days (new plates, dies, litho), repeat orders 14 days
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Lead time 28 days first supply / 14 days repeat for CP-015 & CP-017; 14 days for all other lines. First-supply 28 days exceeds BR-03 21-day target.

edge_cases.title: Ambiguous image-based price (handwritten correction)
edge_cases.location: Rate card row CP-010; all image variants
edge_cases.raw_value: Printed 33.00 struck through; handwritten '30.50' beside it (uninitialled)
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Most likely intended rate Rs 30.50/box; cannot be confirmed from document.
edge_cases.reason: Handwritten override of printed value with no authorisation; digit legibility weak in angled/glare images

edge_cases.title: Possible price outlier
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Value as typed is the extracted value, but it is 150.7% vs historical and ~2x other vendors.

edge_cases.title: Duplicated SKU with mismatched description and price
edge_cases.location: Page 1 row + repeated at end of page 2
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Same SKU quoted twice; cannot tell which is valid. Conservative higher value used for evaluation.

edge_cases.title: Slightly mismatched SKU description
edge_cases.raw_value: CP-014 | 5 Ply Heavy Duty RSC (BF 22) | 450 x 350 x 300
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Map to CP-014 (code + BF22 match) but height 300 vs RFx 250 (300 is CP-007's height). Price taken as CP-014 pending confirmation.

edge_cases.title: Reference to last year's pricing
edge_cases.location: Email paragraph on Hyderabad trays and inserts
edge_cases.raw_value: For the trays and inserts we are already supplying to your Hyderabad plant, remaining items same as last year's pricing.
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Resolve to FY25-26 PO price (historical_reference_prices.csv, last_year_supplier = VND-1005). Email says freight extra, so 5% loading applied conservatively although last year's PO was delivered.
edge_cases.reason: Price not stated in document; depends on external reference and unclear freight basis

edge_cases.title: Conflicting commercial term – table vs note
edge_cases.location: Section 3 terms table vs closing paragraph

raw_value.table: Price validity: 90 days from date of offer

edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Two different validity end dates (2027-01-07 vs 2026-12-31). Use the earlier date conservatively; confirm with vendor.

edge_cases.title: Discount condition buried in note
edge_cases.raw_value: Special discount of 2% on basic value applicable where SCPL annual order value exceeds Rs. 1.50 Crore (excl. GST).
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Conditional discount – not applied to normalized prices; record as scenario (award value-dependent).

edge_cases.title: Hard-to-read row in image
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Legible in clear image; per-100 rate -> per set.
edge_cases.expected_confidence: medium (low if only partial image used)
edge_cases.reason: Vision confidence should drop for this row in the partial image; cross-check with other variants

edge_cases.title: Quote not meeting mandatory spec (uncoated)
edge_cases.location: Rate card row CP-012, remark 'without WR coating'
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Price extracted but line is non-compliant with BR-06; exclude from like-for-like comparison.

edge_cases.title: Missing mandatory certification / failed questionnaire
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Q01 fails (mandatory). Also Q05 partial and Q10 unanswered. Score 44/100 < 70 -> NOT QUALIFIED.
edge_cases.reason: Disqualification must be surfaced regardless of price

edge_cases.title: Strong pricing but poor technical qualification
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Lowest landed price on all baskets but NOT QUALIFIED; must not be recommended for award.
edge_cases.reason: Tests that recommendation logic respects qualification gates

edge_cases.title: Different price-validity periods

raw_value.VND-1003: Table: 90 days; closing paragraph: valid until 31 December 2026 (conflict)

edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Normalize to an end date.
edge_cases.reason: V2, V4, V5 below 90-day minimum (deviation); V3 conflicting (EC-18)

edge_cases.title: Payment terms outside the main table
edge_cases.raw_value: Payment: 45 days from date of invoice.
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Payment terms = 45 days from invoice (acceptable minimum, below 60-day standard).

edge_cases.title: Unclear condition
raw_value: Small-run charges apply below 5,000 on printed boxes – amount not specified
Rates based on current kraft price; increases above 5% to be passed on (no index or mechanism defined)
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Small-run surcharge amount unknown; escalation clause has no index (BR-20 deviation). Cannot be priced.

edge_cases.title: Freight excluded
edge_cases.location: V4 rate card footer; V5 email
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Apply 5% evaluation loading (BR-10) to all lines.

edge_cases.title: Renamed columns, reordered lines, freight in separate column
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Map to RFx fields; landed = basic + freight column.

edge_cases.title: Shorthand item references
raw_value: 5-ply plain (RSC and the big HSC box)
Printed ones Rs 5/kg extra ... 1 & 2 colour 3-ply boxes
trays and inserts we are already supplying to your Hyderabad plant
gift box, mailer, hand-hole box, the sleeve
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Map shorthand to RFx lines by ply/print/category (see canonical_vendor_bids lines).

edge_cases.title: Unquantified tooling charges

raw_value.VND-1002: Cutting dies and printing plates at actuals, one time

edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Tooling cost unknown – report as open item; V3 states INR 1,85,000; V1 absorbs tooling.

edge_cases.title: Lines split across PDF pages
edge_cases.raw_value: Table continues on page 2 with repeated header
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Merge both pages into one table.

edge_cases.title: Image quality variants
edge_cases.correct_interpretation: Same content in all variants. clear = straight capture; angled = perspective + 1.6 deg rotation + uneven lighting; partial = letterhead cut off at top, left edge clipped (the '*' footnote marker and the '7' of '7 Ply' are lost, signature cut), CP-022 row blurred/smudged, slight tilt; glare = specular washout over the middle rows (CP-012 to CP-017 size/description columns). Extraction should be consistent across variants or confidence should drop.
